goals: Contribute the exact audited literal block and accessory families to Clutter No More ShapeMap so approved material forms can share one interchangeable storage family.
Preserve Clutter No More as the sole switching, transmutation, recipe-cleanup, and equivalence authority while keeping component patches and source variants exact.

Use AMC registrations for the Stone accessories and the Andesite, Diorite, and Granite accessory, masonry detail, and Gothic window forms. Integrate the thirteen AMC Mud Bricks forms with the Macaw Mud Brick Gothic Window and Arrow Slit. Integrate the Prismarine Bricks and Dark Prismarine accessories and masonry details, and the eleven thin Prismarine Bricks paths and pavings. Integrate the twelve AMC Sandstone and Red Sandstone forms into their accessory, window, and masonry detail selectors. Integrate the Deepslate, Quartz and Nether Bricks accessory, window, masonry and thin path forms admitted by C21. Integrate End Stone Bricks accessories, windows, masonry details and thin paths and pavings, and the Polished Blackstone Louvered Shutter. Integrate the fifteen AMC Mossy Stone Bricks forms into Button, Column and Window selectors. Integrate the AMC Tuff, Cinnabar, Sulfur and Smooth Basalt accessories, masonry details, windows and thin paths and pavings. Integrate the AMC Veradite, Mirestone and Kurodite forms with the existing polished Enderscape controls. Integrate the 78 AMC Purpur, Dusk Purpur and Resin selector members. Integrate the AMC Calcite and Shadoline Block accessories, masonry, windows and thin paths.
scope: With AMC C32 and Enderscape 3.0.2, 267 families resolve across 2,146 distinct items. With only AMC, 224 families resolve across 1,779 items. With only Enderscape, 181 families resolve across 1,397 items. With neither optional provider, 164 families resolve across 1,348 items. The largest family has 23 members with AMC C32 and 22 without AMC.

Use the actual Minecraft 26.2 and Enderscape 3.0.2 registries as the display-fixture authority: the complete eligible set is the 12 literal vanilla wood families plus Enderscape Veiled, Celestial, and Murublight; Sign is canonical, Hanging Sign and Shelf are alternates, and wall placement blocks are excluded because they are not inventory items.

Preserve pre/post ShapeMap collision validation, equal-component-patch equivalence, fail-closed transfer validation, audited alternate-door loot narrowing, recipe cleanup contracts, Quick Stack Nearby affinity, and large-family viewport handling.
Retain the accepted C7 and historical rollback C3 artifacts while C32 undergoes owner-directed verification.
Extends the Ribbits Mossy Oak fence selector with AMC Frame and Lattice and adds a four-member Trim detail selector.
Adds four 23-member two-high door selectors with native Enderscape and Ribbits parents and 88 AMC Macaw designs.

Adds 17 AMC Macaw alternatives to each native Veiled, Celestial and Murublight trapdoor selector. Groups all 17 AMC Mossy Oak trapdoors under Classic, preserving its crafting recipe and suppressing the other 16.
Adds four 23-member Dramatic Doors tall Macaw selectors and integrates six AMC Bamboo variants into the existing accessory and trapdoor selectors.

exclusions: Clutter No More owns ShapeMap, selection controls, 1:1 transmuteCopy switching, recipe equivalence and cleanup, and the graph consumed by Quick Stack Nearby; IBF does not add a second registry, switcher, keybind, networking protocol, recipe engine, or storage-equivalence system.

Minecraft, Enderscape, Macaw, and Dramatic Doors providers own native blocks, placement, collision, redstone, recipes and costs, drops, copper weathering, waxing, scraping, and lightning behavior; IBF does not normalize or replace those semantics.

Nibaru and Block Geometry Extensions own ordinary slabs, stairs, walls, and generated geometry and material behavior, while Quick Stack Nearby and its compatibility layer only consume Clutter No More affinity; IBF does not modify, duplicate, or bundle those projects.

An absent AMC parent omits its whole family. Without Enderscape, IBF omits families backed by Enderscape or its optional AMC and BBB packs. All active families retain their ordered, registered members and collision guards. A native door without its AMC alternatives remains independent.
C32 is an unaccepted candidate. The server release record and Minecraft testing profiles are separately owned.
Legacy status READMEs, provenance and audit narratives, historical C1/C2 matrices and binaries, manager records, snapshots, branches, worktrees, and Git history are not imported.

dependencies.reason: Provides the Stone accessories and the Button, Pressure Plate, Column, Urn, Moulding, Fence, Frame, Arrow Slit, and Gothic Window for each of Andesite, Diorite, and Granite. C14 also supplies the thirteen Mud Bricks accessory, masonry, and window items. C15 supplies the 27 Prismarine accessory, masonry, path and paving items admitted by C19. C16 supplies six registered forms each for Sandstone and Red Sandstone. C19 supplies the six Deepslate, seventeen Quartz and nineteen Nether Bricks items admitted by C21. C21 supplies the 22 End Stone Bricks forms admitted by C22 and the Polished Blackstone Louvered Shutter. C22 supplies all fifteen Mossy Stone Bricks items. C23 supplies 26 selector members and four independent patterned full blocks per new material. C24 supplies 24 selector members per Enderscape material, including the two alternates for each existing polished control family. C26 supplies Purpur and Resin in the base pack and Dusk Purpur through its Enderscape integration. C28 supplies 26 selector members and four independent full patterns for each of Calcite and Enderscape-backed Shadoline Block. C29 supplies the six Mossy Oak wood forms. C30 supplies 22 Macaw door alternatives for each of Veiled, Celestial, Murublight and Mossy Oak. C31 supplies 17 Macaw trapdoor designs for each wood. The three Enderscape woods have native canonical parents. Classic is the AMC canonical parent for the Mossy Oak trapdoors. C32 supplies five Bamboo accessories and the Bamboo Ranch Trapdoor.

state.milestone: Bamboo and DD tall Macaw selectors passed controlled catalog, provider, recipe, switching, reload and viewport checks. Owner gameplay verification and acceptance are pending.

exceptions.reason: BBB dev.7 supplies the audited Enderscape Frame, Lattice, Trim, Balustrade, Support, and Pallet package. Its provider version does not support Fabric semantic version ordering. The dev.6 provider lacks the required package.
regression_evidence: Fresh C32 BuildingButBetterEnderscapeProviderContractTest, BuildingButBetterFamiliesTest, and ExactProviderArtifactIdentityTest verify exact BBB dev.7 filename, size, SHA-256, the literal provider items, required resources, and Fabric metadata.
The Fabric VersionPredicate equality check accepts dev.7 and rejects the incompatible pre-C9 pale-oak dev.6 package before ShapeMap resolution.

The C32 JUnit suite verified the exact BBB provider. With Enderscape present, both AMC configurations passed 38 controlled GameTests. With Enderscape absent, both passed the focused provider-matrix GameTest.
